decisions.briefing: Markets were flat today (NASDAQ +0.2%, S&P500 +0.3%) with no clear risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($289.29) sits below the $500 deployment threshold, so per prior lessons we're holding rather than forcing a buy — existing 7 positions stay untouched to let stop-loss/profit-target rules do their job.

market_education.summary_en: Both major indices drifted slightly higher today in quiet, low-conviction trading with no major catalyst driving the move. Volume and volatility were subdued, consistent with a market waiting for its next directional cue. Without a clear breakout signal, this was a session to sit tight rather than chase.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市走勢平穩，納指升0.2%，標普500指數升0.3%，成交淡靜，未見明顯利好或利淡消息帶動。市場似乎在等待下一個方向性訊號，波動性偏低。在缺乏明確突破信號下，今日屬於觀望而非追高的日子。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder means keeping cash uninvested and ready to deploy when a genuinely strong opportunity appears, rather than forcing trades just to stay fully invested. On a neutral day with cash below a meaningful deployment size, patience preserves capital for better setups.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指保留現金不投資，待真正出現強勢機會時才出手，而非為求「滿倉」而勉強交易。在大市方向不明、現金金額又不足以有效配置時，保持耐性能為日後更佳機會保留彈藥。
